expectations.text: uses-layered-architecture: Uses layered_architecture.py (Matplotlib renderer) or explicitly references layered-architecture type

expectations.evidence: generic flowchart: False, has layered YAML: True

expectations.evidence: has YAML: True, custom: True, --layout: False

expectations.text: layer-dashed-borders: Layers are visually separated (dashed lines, distinct backgrounds) — signature of the skill's renderer

expectations.text: layer-labels: Each layer has a visible label/name on the left side
